description: Role-scoped knowledge sharing — a worker role in one project learns from a worker role in another project that hit the same capability failure.
instructions: Guild knowledge is scoped by role (planner, worker, validator) and capability.
A worker role can query the guild for failures encountered by other worker instances for the same capability across projects.
Role isolation: planner knowledge does not mix with worker knowledge.
Knowledge includes: capability name, error class, resolved input adjustments, and a confidence score based on occurrence count.
